description: Search companies, people, deals, or tasks with complex nested filters (e.g., find deals by owner+stage, companies by industry+location). Never mutate records; use update_record or delete_record. Supports filter groups, scoring, pagination, and up to 100 items. Requires resource_type parameter. If filters fail, fetch valid attributes via discover_record_attributes.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

resource_type.description: Type of resource to operate on. Standard types: companies, people, deals, tasks, lists, records, notes. Custom objects (e.g., "funds", "investment_opportunities") are also supported after running `attio-discover attributes -a`.

name: search_records_advanced
